budget_accounting: conservative input ceilings of 4.5/2.25 cover standard input plus 30-minute cache writes; full output reservation before each request; no cache savings assumed
empirical_basis: completed prior 40-document stage including rejection and retries; conservative accounted cost, not invoice

exclusions.limits: exact, normalized, numeric/email skeleton and shingle checks are contamination heuristics; semantic novelty is unverified
exclusions.old_holdout_use: fingerprinting for exclusion only; no labels inspected or classifier evaluation

fx_and_fees: planning assumptions: SGD1.50/USD and 20% contingency; not a current exchange-rate quote
limits: 40 documents is a small synthetic check, not independent legal ground truth.
Three passes of the same judge model have correlated errors.
Budget or candidate limits may prevent coverage; report incomplete runs without forced labels.
Unknown request charges retain their reserve and are not automatically retried.
No authorization file or paid calls are created by preparation.
novelty_limits: Reserved IDs and source fingerprints are disjoint; semantic novelty and model-training independence are unverified. Accepted family balance is not enforced; report actual composition and rejected cases.

plan.coverage_policy: stop at accepted quotas or candidate/budget limit; report shortfalls without forced labels

groups.scenario: fictional listed issuer executive succession handover log; use terse entries and natural paraphrases for the decision, economic significance and release chronology rather than stock boilerplate
fictional listed issuer court injunction and plant access coordination; use correspondence with multiple organizations and distinguish their roles, economic consequences and disclosure chronology
fictional listed issuer independent mineral reserve reassessment; use a technical liaison note with ordinary paraphrases, source qualifications and a chronology of release status
fictional listed issuer shareholder voting control agreement and registry coordination; use a question-and-answer brief separating routine records from issuer developments and publication timing

spending_limit.interpretation: USD provider cap enforced; SGD amount conditional on FX/fee assumptions, not bank invoice verification

plan.voting_interpretation: three separate samples of one model; agreement is not cross-model corroboration

planning_estimate_basis: highest accounted cost among completed earlier 40-document stages plus 25%, rounded up

predeclared_evaluation_policy.adaptation: no classifier, prompt, threshold or selection changes after generation begins
predeclared_evaluation_policy.outcome_policy: preserve the first result, including failures and coverage shortfalls; no replacement cohort
predeclared_evaluation_policy.references: model-reference agreement only; independent accuracy and calibrated confidence unavailable
predeclared_evaluation_policy.success_condition: all frozen engineering targets pass; comparison with baseline is descriptive

release: one-shot paired evaluation after complete quadrant/entity coverage; consume before metrics; no tuning or retrying the evaluation
selection: judge-only quadrant and subtype coverage; classifier predictions never select documents

verification.full_classifier_suite: not repeated; detector source unchanged from verified v6 (1925 tests and 254 subtests per Python runtime)
verification.resolved_quality_checks: Initial Ruff line-length findings corrected; final lint and format checks pass.
